metadata.title: 80s Retro Pop Album Cover with Geometric Badge

retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus portrait overlaid with a complex geometric badge featuring concentric circles and an inverted triangle in pastel tones.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, soft-focus portrait of a woman with voluminous hair, partially obscured in the upper left by a multi-layered graphic badge consisting of an inverted light blue triangle, a lavender ring, and a yellow central circle.
coreVisualRelationships: Graphic badge anchored to the top-left corner overlapping the subject
Soft, warm-toned portrait contrasting with sharp geometric shapes
Concentric circular text paths within the badge
Pastel color palette in the graphics against natural skin and hair tones
coreInvariants: Inverted isosceles triangle background for the badge
Concentric circular layout for primary display text
Soft-focus photographic style with warm lighting

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to a tight headshot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The geometric badge in the top-left corner acts as the primary focal point for information.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast badge, move down the diagonal of the triangle to the subject's face, and settle on the bottom metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is filled with the subject's hair and the graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and skin tones in the photograph.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lavender and light blue in the geometric badge.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow circle and magenta text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements against muted, soft-value photographic tones.

letterConstructionRules: High-waisted condensed serifs for the main name
Uniform stroke width for circular path text
Blocky, wide sans-serif for bottom branding
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed serif for the subject name paired with a clean sans-serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Inverted triangle with thin black outline
Concentric circles with thin black outlines
Horizontal dividing lines through the badge

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-waisted, traditional serif feel of the main name.
Appropriate for the secondary circular text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus 1980s style portrait of a woman with voluminous reddish-brown hair, warm lighting, and a neutral background. Leave the top-left corner clear for a graphic overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add an inverted light blue triangle in the top left. Overlap it with a lavender ring containing circular text and a central yellow circle containing two lines of condensed magenta serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the main name in a condensed serif font?
Are the colors pastel (lavender, cyan, yellow)?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the display text
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Clean vector lines for the badge

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible within the circular path
The badge does not fully obscure the subject's eyes
The magenta text contrasts clearly against the yellow circle
The overall composition feels balanced despite the heavy top-left graphic
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + Top-left geometric badge (Triangle + Circle) + Condensed Serif Typography.
